title: Research: prove the connector optimum under output delivery cuts
body:
Per-output request/delivery cuts change the optimum of a persistent dirty connector. This proves the complete-alphabet weighted query formula and gives an attaining online word: all 31 five-source masks cost 142 queries instead of 222 separate row stars. The 74-query offline word has the same endpoint but violates delivery cuts. An independent Dijkstra engine checks 954 exact quotient cases plus chronological failure controls; no selected caller is instantiated.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c573bc769798ce4e336fd5be630060bd9d69a71/research/connector-delivery-cut-optimum/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
